name: auth
description: Accounts and sessions from Better Auth on one mount; protected routes receive the signed-in user id

authoring.description: Accounts and sessions served by Better Auth on one extension mount. Protect a route with `auth: true`; its function reads the signed-in user id from context.capabilities.auth.identity.userId. Permissions (roles, ownership) are application data keyed by that id.

surfaces.name: mount
surfaces.description: Mount Better Auth at one path, for example /api/auth/* with extension: auth and methods [GET, POST]. Only the operator-enabled Better Auth endpoints answer; everything else under it is 404.

surfaces.name: route protection
surfaces.description: `auth: true` on a route requires a verified Better Auth session and refuses cross-origin unsafe methods; the route receives no cookie or Authorization header.

agent.description: Local, revision-pinned references for agents protecting routes with the auth extension.

references.name: auth extension guide
references.description: Mounting Better Auth, protecting routes with auth: true, reading the user id, the operator CLI and what is not included.

references.name: auth security model
references.description: What Better Auth owns, what the mount and route gate enforce, and the operator responsibilities.
